create_sample_dict: create a sample dictionary with source tokens and targets for transformer model testing
build_transformer_model: build a tiny transformer model with configurable embedding dimensions and zero dropout for testing
test_forward_backward_pass: test the transformer model forward and backward pass with matching encoder decoder dimensions
test_different_embed_dims: test the transformer model forward and backward pass with different encoder decoder embedding dimensions
run_transformer_unit_tests: run the unittest test case suite for transformer model forward and backward pass validation
